QuestInfo.name: [9th Anniversary Par-tay] Sprucing up the Joint
QuestInfo.0: There's something that needs to be done before the party starts. Go ask Cassandra about it.
QuestInfo.1: Gather Crumpled Paper from normal monsters. Just remember, you have to fight monsters around your level. No more than 11 lower or 21 higher!
QuestInfo.2: Now that the big clean up is finished, what next?

default.0: Double-check that you've gathered all the Crumpled Paper you need.

npc.0: Go talk to Inkie at the 9th Anniversary Park. You can use the Dimensional Mirror or the Teleport Rock that I gave you.
